//: Runs `dotnet test` in Microsoft.Testing.Platform mode rather than VSTest mode, for the
Windows AI helper's tests (windows_ai_helper/IdtWindowsAI.Tests), the repo's only .NET tests.
Required, not preference: Microsoft.Testing.Platform 2.x, which xunit.v3 4.x brings in,
refuses to run under the VSTest target on the .NET 10 SDK ('Testing with VSTest target is no
longer supported'). The SDK reads the runner choice from global.json, found from the folder
dotnet is run in, so it lives at the repo root, where CI runs it.
What this changes for callers: pass the project with --project rather than positionally.
No sdk section on purpose: any .NET 10 SDK builds.
